bio: Every mining crew has someone like Garnatt. A Dwarf so rock solid, they pulverize stone with their bare hands. Garnatt's career nearly ended when he punched a parasitic gem that started to eat his whole body. He immediately ordered his fellow miners to carve the rock into a set of gauntlets. He now punches harder than ever. Funny how life works out.
